title: Inheritance and Letter
author: Orsen Nystrom
blurb: Ivo Winterbourne, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
